Besides [[Hugh (DS)|Hugh]], Kate is one of the only children living in the valley and often feels bored living in the valley. A bit mischievous, Kate is a handful to raise for her father [[Grant (DS)|Grant]]. Kate's mother up and left Grant, and Kate feels resentment towards her father, straining their relationship. Furthermore, Grant works long hours in the city which often leaves Kate at home alone. Kate enjoys visiting Romana's mansion. She often playfully picks on [[Hugh (DS)|Hugh]], although the two appear to be friends. When your child is born, Kate will age by a few years, growing into a teenager. Her likes and dislikes change as she ages, as well as her appearance. She acts a bit more lady like, and takes up an interest in becoming a writer.
